headline: In Hungary, Paks NPP's operations are being saved: a sluice has opened on the Danube section Rácalmás-Shorokshar
summary: A sluice opened on the Rácalmás–Shorokshar Danube section adds 20 cubic metres of water per second, which Prime Minister Péter Magyar says may raise Paks NPP's water level by two centimetres.
why: Paks is Hungary's only nuclear power plant, and it depends on Danube water levels for its cooling.

original_headline: В Венгрии спасают работу АЭС "Пакш": на отрезке Дуная Рацкеве-Шорокшар открыт шлюз
